examples.text: Toeava went over unopposed to stretch his side's lead but Japan got on the scoreboard on 56 minutes, wing Hirotoki Onozawa intercepting an attempted offload from Slade, who had a rather flaky game, and running in from the All Blacks' 10m line.

examples.text: The driver of the car carrier offloaded the cars at the dealership.

examples.text: He offloaded the defective car onto an unsuspecting buyer.
